HELP_TEXT.TITLE: How to use the Slack Integration?
HELP_TEXT.BODY:
With this integration, all of your incoming conversations will be synced to the ***{selectedChannelName}*** channel in your Slack workspace. You can manage all your customer conversations right within the channel and never miss a message.

Here are the main features of the integration:

**Respond to conversations from within Slack:** To respond to a conversation in the ***{selectedChannelName}*** Slack channel, simply type out your message and send it as a thread. This will create a response back to the customer through OneLink. It's that simple!

 **Create private notes:** If you want to create private notes instead of replies, start your message with ***`note:`***. This ensures that your message is kept private and won't be visible to the customer.

**Associate an agent profile:** If the person who replied on Slack has an agent profile in OneLink under the same email, the replies will be associated with that agent profile automatically. This means you can easily track who said what and when. On the other hand, when the replier doesn't have an associated agent profile, the replies will appear from the bot profile to the customer.

PROSPECTIVE_BUYER.TITLE: Prospective Buyer
PROSPECTIVE_BUYER.DESCRIPTION: Handle customers who are showing interest in purchasing a license
PROSPECTIVE_BUYER.INSTRUCTION:
If someone is interested in purchasing a license, ask them for the following:

1. How many licenses are they willing to purchase?
2. Are they migrating from another platform?

Once these details are collected, do the following steps:
1. Add a private note with the information you collected using [Add Private Note](tool://add_private_note)
2. Add label "sales" to the conversation using [Add Tag to Conversation](tool://add_label_to_conversation)
3. Reply saying "one of us will reach out soon", provide an estimated timeline for the response, and [Handoff to Human](tool://handoff)

BILLING_ISSUE.TITLE: Complex billing issue
BILLING_ISSUE.DESCRIPTION: Collect billing context for failed charges, disputed invoices, or payment confusion before handing off
BILLING_ISSUE.INSTRUCTION: If the user reports a billing issue, first collect the invoice or payment reference, the charge date, and a short summary of the problem. Then save that context using [Add Private Note](tool://add_private_note) and hand the conversation to a human using [Handoff to Human](tool://handoff).

ONBOARDING_HELP.TITLE: Onboarding help
ONBOARDING_HELP.DESCRIPTION: Guide new customers through the next setup step and escalate quickly when onboarding gets blocked
ONBOARDING_HELP.INSTRUCTION: If the user is just getting started, identify which setup step they are on, then use [FAQ Lookup](tool://faq_lookup) to guide the next action. If the issue remains blocked after clarification, transfer the conversation to a human using [Handoff to Human](tool://handoff).
